context-compiler.name: Context Compiler
context-compiler.description: Analytics contract generation, SQL analysis, and context intelligence for ClickHouse

tools.name: analyze_clickhouse_query
tools.description: Analyze ClickHouse SQL queries for performance, correctness, and best practices

query.description: The ClickHouse SQL query to analyze

context.description: Optional business context or purpose of the query

tools.name: generate_analytics_contract
tools.description: Generate an analytics contract from a feature specification with entities, metrics, and relationships

feature_spec.description: Feature specification describing what to track and analyze

events.description: List of event names to include in the analysis

tools.name: execute_clickhouse_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only ClickHouse SQL query and return results for data exploration

query.description: The SELECT query to execute (must be read-only)

database.description: Database name (optional, uses default if not specified)

tools.name: get_context_entities
tools.description: Retrieve approved context entities and their definitions to see available data structures and metrics

tools.name: check_context_drift
tools.description: Check for drift between approved context and observed events to identify missing events, extra fields, or schema changes

entity_name.description: Entity name to check for drift
